messages: maya: Quick mock of the Create Model form — thinking we switch to per-field compact errors by default and only show a top summary banner if there are 3+ errors or a server-side issue. link: https://mock.redwood/designs/pm-form :thinking: ryan: I like per-field for quick fixability. Top banner is useful for bulk submissions or infra errors. :+1: sofia: Accessibility note — an asterisk alone is ambiguous to SRs. Prefer adding visually-hidden 'required' text and aria-describedby for the field. maya: Agreed. Plan is: visible asterisk + sr-only "required" text for screen readers. Small example below: ```html ``` jordan: On destructive actions — for "Reset model params" do we require typed confirm (type RESET) or modal checkbox? Typed confirm prevents accidents but is slow for power users. alex: Typed confirm for org-level destructive ops only. For team-level actions use modal + emphasized warning + undo toast. Balances safety and speed. sofia: For modal a11y we need role="alertdialog", focus trap, and clear label for the cancel button. Also ensure screen reader doesn't auto-trigger the default action with Enter on the input. a11y-bot: Reminder: if using aria-live for error summary, mark region as aria-live="assertive" only for critical failures to avoid verbosity. ryan: For the top summary banner, add jump links to each field error ("Jump to first error"). That keeps summary useful but still lets users fix inline. maya: Great, sounds like consensus: default per-field inline errors + top summary for many/server errors, sr-only required text, typed confirm only for org-destruct, undo for others, and jump links. I’ll post updated mock with a11y annotations this afternoon. Thanks!
